k1.author: curator-C
k1.quote: svc.apply(app) submits an application. Application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.
k1.text: Call svc.apply(app) to submit an application. Application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.

k2.author: curator-C
k2.quote: svc.apply now returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved" | "declined" | "manual_review", "credit_limit": <int>}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed.
k2.text: Redfern is on API v2 (current). svc.apply returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved" | "declined" | "manual_review", "credit_limit": <int>}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed.

k3.author: curator-C
k3.quote: outcome manual_review replaces refer and is handled as in spec section 3.
k3.text: handle(app, svc) maps the outcome to an action: approved → issue the card with the returned credit_limit; declined → decline the application; manual_review → place in the manual review queue (action queue_review), do not decline. (manual_review replaces the v1 "refer" and is handled per spec section 3.)

k4.author: curator-C
k4.quote: For every partner in the network, whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k4.text: Network referral rule: whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
